title: DEAR loving Shepherd of Thy sheep

lines.text: DEAR loving Shepherd of Thy sheep
Reveal Thyself to us
Thou gives us here a house of prayer
Do make our hearts to pray.
Grant us that love divine and peace
Reign supreme in Thine House
Give comfort to the troubled soul
Give strength to the weary.
Let us, in faith list' to Thy words
In faith, present our plea
And here before Thy presence, Lord
Unburden all our woes.
Amen.
